causes_dates_check.name: causes_dates_check
causes_dates_check.value: starts_on is null or ends_on is null or ends_on >= starts_on

causes_type_rules_check.name: causes_type_rules_check
causes_type_rules_check.value:
coalesce(
          (cause_type = 'campaign' and target_paisa is not null and ends_on is not null
            and target_period is null and stock_year_start_month is null)
          or (cause_type = 'ongoing' and ends_on is null
            and target_period in ('monthly', 'yearly') and stock_year_start_month is null)
          or (cause_type = 'yearly_stock' and ends_on is null
            and target_period is null and stock_year_start_month between 1 and 12),
          false
        )

donations_bank_reference_check.name: donations_bank_reference_check
donations_bank_reference_check.value: length(bank_reference) between 1 and 120 and bank_reference = btrim(bank_reference) and bank_reference !~ '[[:cntrl:]]'

donors_email_check.name: donors_email_check
donors_email_check.value: length(email) <= 254 and email = lower(btrim(email)) and email ~ '^[^[:space:]@]+@[^[:space:]@]+[.][^[:space:]@]+$'

institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_typ.name: institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_types_check
institute_bank_accounts_for_donation_typ.value: (cardinality(for_donation_types) > 0) AND (array_position(for_donation_types, NULL::text) IS NULL) AND (for_donation_types <@ ARRAY['zakat'::text, 'sadaqah'::text, 'general'::text])

institute_bank_accounts_check.name: institute_bank_accounts_check
institute_bank_accounts_check.value: (NULLIF(btrim(account_number), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) OR (NULLIF(btrim(iban), ''::text) IS NOT NULL)

media_read.name: media_read
media_read.using:
(select app.has_role('admin')) or (
  uploaded_by = (select app.current_user_id())
  and (select app.is_member() or app.has_role('donor'))
)

media_assets_check1.name: media_assets_check1
media_assets_check1.value:
(bytes > 0) AND (bytes <=
CASE
    WHEN (purpose = 'avatar'::text) THEN 60000
    WHEN (kind = 'image'::text) THEN 600000
    WHEN (kind = ANY (ARRAY['audio'::text, 'slides'::text])) THEN 10000000
    WHEN (kind = 'document'::text) THEN 5000000
    WHEN (kind = 'video'::text) THEN 25000000
    ELSE 0
END)

media_assets_check5.name: media_assets_check5
media_assets_check5.value: ((kind = 'youtube'::text) AND (youtube_id IS NOT NULL) AND (storage_key IS NULL) AND (mime_type IS NULL) AND (bytes IS NULL)) OR ((kind <> 'youtube'::text) AND (storage_key IS NOT NULL) AND (mime_type IS NOT NULL) AND (bytes IS NOT NULL) AND (youtube_id IS NULL))

site_page_drafts_facts_check.name: site_page_drafts_facts_check
site_page_drafts_facts_check.value: facts is null or (slug = 'home' and app.valid_home_facts(facts))

site_pages_facts_check.name: site_pages_facts_check
site_pages_facts_check.value: facts is null or (slug = 'home' and app.valid_home_facts(facts))

trail_events_manual_shape_check.name: trail_events_manual_shape_check
trail_events_manual_shape_check.value: (event_type = 'received' and cause_id is null and allocation_id is null) or (event_type = 'allocated' and cause_id is not null and allocation_id is not null)

user_read.name: user_read
user_read.using:
(id = (select app.current_user_id()) and status in ('active', 'left'))
  or (select app.has_role('admin'))

users_check.name: users_check
users_check.value: (email IS NOT NULL) OR (username IS NOT NULL)
